title: lastpatch history of published end dates
description: Every end date data/devices.json has published for each row key (vendor, model, hardware version, region), in order. Updated by scripts/build.js on every build; entries are only appended or extended, never deleted, and keys that leave devices.json keep their history.

generated.description: The `generated` date of the latest dataset build recorded.

vendor.description: As written in the latest build that had this key.

shortened.description: True when at least one entry of `dates` is flagged `shortened`.

dates.description: One entry per run of the same end date, oldest first. A date that comes back after a change gets a new entry.

support_end.description: The end date as published in devices.json (null when the source gave no date).

support_end_raw.description: The source text recorded when this date was first seen.

first_seen.description: `generated` date of the first dataset build with this date. Not the date the manufacturer published it.

last_seen.description: `generated` date of the latest dataset build with this date; null while it is still the current date of a row in the dataset.

source_url.description: The source cited when this date was first seen.

shortened.description: Present when this end date is earlier than an end date published before it for the same key (since the last correction).

correction.description: Present when the change comes from how the dataset reads the source, not from a new date published by the manufacturer. Set by hand after review; a correction is never flagged as shortened, and the dates before it are not compared with the ones after it.

note.description: Why the date changed, when known.
